mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name AS name, g.group_name, g.group_id, g.group_type, r.role_name, r.role_id FROM group_members gm JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.group_id AND g.is_active='O1' JOIN roles r ON gm.role_id = r.role_id JOIN users u ON gm.user_id = u.user_id WHERE g.group_type = 'C2' AND g.is_active = 'O1' AND u.is_active = 'O1' AND u.user_type='M2' ORDER BY (CASE WHEN g.group_id = 31 THEN 1 WHEN g.group_id = 32 THEN 2 WHEN g.group_id = 33 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END), g.group_name

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name AS name, g.group_name, g.group_type, g.group_id FROM users u JOIN group_members gm ON u.user_id = gm.user_id AND gm.is_active = 'O1' AND gm.is_primary = 'Y' LEFT JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.group_id AND g.is_active='O1' WHERE u.is_active='O1' AND u.user_type='M2' ORDER BY (CASE WHEN g.group_id = 31 THEN 1 WHEN g.group_id = 32 THEN 2 WHEN g.group_id = 33 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END), g.group_name
